title: The harm of class imbalance corrections for risk prediction models: illustration and simulation using logistic regression
study_context: Logistic-regression simulations and an ovarian tumour diagnosis illustration.
population_or_data: Logistic-regression simulations and an ovarian tumour diagnosis illustration.
main_findings: In the examined logistic-regression settings, undersampling, oversampling and SMOTE did not improve discrimination and overestimated minority-class probabilities; sensitivity and specificity could also be changed by adjusting the decision threshold.
limitations: Selected-page review only: PDF p.1, Abstract. Text extracted and page visually checked on 2026-10-07.
Published article; PMC open-access copy, CC BY 4.0.
Transfer to cardiac WSI MIL requires qualification.
does_not_establish: Does not establish the effect of resampling on neural WSI MIL, diagnose calibration in SMC, or explain the cause of the observed SMC AP differences.
relevance_to_project: Rebalancing need not improve discrimination, and decision thresholds must be distinguished from probability calibration.
